description: This file defines the OAuthClientModel class, which represents an API model for OAuth client data within the OrangeHRM application. It includes annotations for API documentation and handles serialization details for OAuth client entities.

classes.name: OAuthClientModel
classes.description: Represents the OAuth client model used in API responses, encapsulating properties like id, name, client ID, redirect URI, and flags for enabled and confidentiality status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the OAuthClientModel with an OAuthClient entity and sets serialization filters and attribute mappings.
